notablePrerequisites: Yurlok of Scorch Thrash and Magus of the Candelabra do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Yurlok of Scorch Thrash by paying {1} and tapping it, causing each player to add {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Yurlok of Scorch Thrash.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to your next step or phase, causing each player to lose life equal to the amount of unspent mana in their mana pool.
